opening.comment: The agent gave only the company name and did not state their own name, so the opening is incomplete.

verification.quote: Agent: Name and order number or postcode.
verification.comment: The agent asked for name and order number before discussing the order, which meets the verification requirement.

understanding.quote: Agent: Okay, Ahmed. Order 804257, a lamp at €44.50, in transit for 12 working days. So nothing at all has arrived?
understanding.comment: The agent captured the issue accurately and did not re-ask for details the caller had already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Agent: Right. I've opened a lost parcel investigation. It closes within 9 working days and then we send a replacement within 3 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The policy says the investigation closes within 5 working days, not 9, so the stated timeline is wrong.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: I'm putting you on hold.
process_compliance.comment: The agent placed the caller on hold without asking permission and did not thank them on return, as the policy requires.

communication.quote: Customer: My parcel never arrived. It's been 12 working days in I'm absolutely furious, this his the second time.
communication.comment: The caller said they were furious and the agent never acknowledged the frustration, and the agent's tone was curt.

closing.quote: Agent: You'll get an email when the investigation closes. Is there anything else I can help with?
closing.comment: The agent confirmed the next step and asked if there was anything else, which closes the call properly.
